scope: Independent read-only review of real Comfy decode/checkpoint/lifecycle dependencies and the new frozen bounded joint RGB CLI. No launch approval or empirical joint-model acceptance.

resolved_findings.resolution: restore_patcher_state checks initialization before accessing saved fields, records not-applicable session restoration, and still repairs whole-run state.

key_checks.result: Strict final video/audio parity precedes candidate decode. The retained video feeds ResidentH3Trajectory.decode without detach; decoder FP16 input SHA matches reference. RGB allclose(candidate,reference) uses unchanged atol=.0002/rtol=.0001 and reports bitexact. One CPU float32 RGB-only MSE times1024 drives the retained graph; no latent/audio auxiliary objective or optimizer.

Block observers wrap bound forward before checkpoint captures it, so they see recomputation inside context_fn. Decoder forward/recompute uses scoped ascend_native; each context restores its full prior state. DiT candidate/backward uses its own session-entry expectation. Reference and candidate temporary scale_shift/gate function IDs are not incorrectly equated.

disable_offload alone cannot protect DiT: VAE load_models_gpu may free other models. The new CLI checks canonical object/version/device/byte/frozen state before and after decode and before backward. It blocks sd.VAE OOM fallback entrypoints and repeated stage.decode, preserving native stage.tiled_decode and successful decode arithmetic.

Defaults ratio_t=4, clip17, token_drop3, chunk5, overlap2 give _decode_temporal_chunks(2)=(5,1): T2 is padded to7, not8. Native128<tile256 gives one spatial tile; one decoder invocation visits36 blocks. This is a source-derived predeclared count, not a claimed prior5-frame measured checkpoint count. The probe logs actual native plan and actual counts before strict acceptance.

Parameters and all registered buffers, including nonpersistent buffers, are fingerprinted separately; untracked Python caches are explicitly outside scope. Raw and FP32-unscaled gradients are saved; final state/hash/runtime observations are attempted before complete/failure verdict. Aggregate B must be nonzero; A can be zero at zero B. Adapter values cannot change without an optimizer.

Success requires3reference+3candidate explicit NFE,1reference+1candidate VAE decode,1backward,0optimizer/update; DiT150 and VAE36 checkpoint block recomputes are separately counted. No extra whole-model backward forward, no encode, and no OOM fallback is admitted.

Entrypoint, existing source contract, manifest, complete implementation pins and actual context-file SHA are checked before execution; model loader then verifies bound asset bytes. Inspect-only does not claim all asset-byte hashes were verified.

Real model must independently pass strict latent parity, existing RGB tolerance, finite nonzero RGB-to-adapter gradients, declared counters, freeze and all restoration gates.
